verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for a state online business-filing portal. However, none of the evidence pack's items (filing-service page titles, the DOR licensing pages, the My DOR portal probe, or the in-person same-day fee note) mention any availability window, per-day limit, or session timeout for the online flow. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.
